# Escalation Fixture

## Proposed Change

A proposed Workflow Delivery second-slice investigation needs a real NuGet
publication to answer a question that public sources leave unresolved. The
accepted scope allows desk research and documentary handoff only. No accepted
entry or protocol bounds publication or accepts its external effects.

## Expected Review
